primary_object_card.object_statement: A behavioral object is a probe-relative equivalence class of finite states that remains indistinguishable under every admitted action history through the declared refinement depth; a learned proxy may predict this relation but cannot define or certify it.
primary_object_card.plain_language_definition: States count as the same object only when the declared probes cannot distinguish them now or after any admitted action history through the frozen finite depth. Exact refinement defines the object. A neural model can only predict the resulting same-object relation on held-out action families.

source_anchors.quote_or_summary: The v0 fixture defines objects by probe outcomes under all action histories and blocks learned labels from semantic authority.
The accepted v0 ceiling is exact finite semantics plus topology-dependent fitting; engine nonredundancy and unseen-object transfer remain red.

native_terms.behavioral object: An equivalence class induced by a frozen probe family and action-history language.
native_terms.held-out action family: A rule or rule pair excluded from model fitting and threshold selection.
native_terms.semantic owner: The exact finite construction that defines labels and checks congruence; never the learned proxy.

weirdness_signature: identity is probe-relative rather than intrinsic
future action histories participate in present object identity
a learned presentation-invariant proxy is not the object factory
primary_object_card.domain: finite six-site binary rings, frozen probe family, and preregistered ECA rule-pair splits
primary_object_card.codomain_or_output: exact behavioral partitions, same-object pair labels, quotient receipts, and bounded learned predictions
allowed_operations: fit a graph proxy on training families
required_invariants: test rule families never enter fitting or threshold selection
exact labels are generated independently of the neural model
object identity always names its probe and action scope
presentation symmetry does not count as unseen-object transfer
runtime-role removal cannot be called mathematical uniqueness
forbidden_substitutions: cyclic orbit label as universal object identity
runtime language name as unique intelligence
aggregate accuracy without class-balanced and trivial baselines
primary_object_card.adapter_policy: ECA, graph, JAX, Julia, and PyTorch surfaces are typed probes or adapters. None may replace the probe-relative equivalence relation.
promotion_locks: no unseen-object claim without complete held-out action families
no engine-intelligence claim from language-level role assignment
no QIT or cross-domain promotion from a classical ECA fixture
primary_object_card.artifact_surface: versioned repo packet with preregistration, independent engine receipts, validator, and fabrication audit
blocked_downstream_consumers: Axis0, physics, life, or consciousness claims

lateral_mappings.kill_control: replace both actions by the same rule; order-sensitive claims must fail

lateral_mappings.kill_control: erase graph edges or rule identity; held-out performance must demote

preconditions: ablation measures missing evidence, not impossible computation
lateral_mappings.kill_control: a clean reimplementation in another universal runtime defeats uniqueness wording

demote runtime uniqueness to workflow evidence if cross-runtime reimplementation is possible

loop_contract.repair_rule: repair the first object-preservation or leakage failure before tuning the model
loop_contract.stop_condition: all preservation and leakage checks pass, or held-out transfer/T9 is decisively red

method_contracts.question_is_not_authorization: A question asks for an answer; it is not authorization to implement unless the user explicitly says to do it.
method_contracts.order_check_separate: Any sequence or ordering claim must be checked separately from content correctness, with the order witness named.
method_contracts.baseline_preservation: When debugging runtime behavior, preserve the tuned visible/output baseline and debug the execution path underneath.
method_contracts.falsifier_first: A Popper pass names the target claim, strongest live falsifier, decisive check, and killed/open/survived classification before agreement.
method_contracts.feynman_testability: A Feynman pass names the operation, the observable measured, and the pass/fail condition.
method_contracts.synthesis_refusal: Synthesis must name distinct receipts and explicitly refuse the merge, sequence, or reframe it is not performing.
method_contracts.human_offload: Resolve with tools before asking; ask the human only for private, preference-bound, or unrecoverable information.

evidence_spine.wizard_runtime: Wizard v4.3 object-preservation guard; v4.2 surfaces are legacy/provenance and are not the current run target.

source_math_locks.preserves: the original finite behavioral-equivalence construction and its bounded carrier

sim_audit_receipts.status: validator green; scientific aggregate red on T9
sim_audit_receipts.claim_ceiling: exact v0 finite fixture plus topology-dependent fitting only
semantic audit of the v0 packet only

evidence_spine.claim_ceiling: object-preservation and benchmark preflight only; no unseen-object, T9, QIT, stage, Axis0, physics, or consciousness claim
blocked_consumers: model training before object-card and preregistration validation
